svg.title: One request we can follow token by token
svg.desc: Exact user prompt: Continue the sequence with three numbers: 2, 4, 6, System: You are a helpful assistant. Reply with only the requested numbers. Full chat input: 42 tokens. Actual output: 8, 10, 12. 10 selected tokens including any stop token; stop reason eos.
